text: さてと…　でんきこうじに　いかなくちゃ

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.explanation: なくちゃ is the casual short form of なくては, 'if I don't', with the 'it won't do' part dropped. Together it means 'have to'. いかなくちゃ = 'I have to go'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: でんきこうじに　いかなくちゃ
patterns.explanation: に before いく shows what you are going for. でんきこうじに いかなくちゃ = 'I have to go do my electrical work'.
